title: #055. Rooted Connected Subgraph via Single-Commodity Flow
subtitle: Select a prize-collecting connected cluster rooted at node 0 using single-commodity flow to forbid disconnected islands.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selectedNodes, selectedEdges, netValue }.
judge.m2: Root node 0 must always be selected (selectedNodes[0] == 1).
judge.m4: Selected edge {p0} ({p1}-{p2}) requires both endpoints to be selected.
judge.m5: Selected node {p0} is disconnected from root node 0 along selectedEdges.
judge.m6: Reported netValue ({p0}) does not match prize sum minus edge cost ({p1}).
judge.m7: Valid connected subgraph, but netValue ({p0}) is below maximum ({p1}).
judge.m8: Optimal connected subgraph rooted at node 0 found (netValue = {p0})!
